description.fr-FR: Les lettres de Fénelon à ses parents, ses neveux et les siens (deuxième section de la correspondance). Les lettres adressées à Fénelon sont imprimées avec les siennes là où l’édition les place.
description.en-US: Fénelon’s letters to his relatives and nephews (second section of the correspondence). Letters written to Fénelon are printed with his own where the edition places them.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de Fénelon a seus parentes e sobrinhos (segunda seção da correspondência). As cartas escritas a Fénelon são impressas com as dele onde a edição as coloca.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 7, tome 7, section II; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
